requirements.text: * Experience with Linux system administration, user and access management, and automation
* Demonstrated expertise in scripting languages for system tooling and automation (bash, Python, etc.)
* Experience with containers (Docker) and scheduling/orchestration systems (Slurm, Kubernetes)
* Experience running production services, including monitoring and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), deployment pipelines, and incident response
* Experience building tooling for cluster validation and reliability (accelerator, networking, and storage health checks)
* Experience setting up and managing developer tools and third-party services (e.g., cloud storage providers, Docker Hub, Slack, Gmail, Telegraf, experiment trackers)
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills across compute, storage, and networking
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams
* Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Ansible, Terraform)
* Prior work supporting ML/AI infrastructure, including GPU management and workload optimization
* Experience deploying and operating LLM serving stacks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, Ray)
* Experience with multiple accelerator platforms (e.g., NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, TPUs)
* Experience with high-performance networking (InfiniBand, RoCE) and distributed storage
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Familiarity with Apptainer and with integrating containers into Slurm and Kubernetes
